title: Our Kirtipur
description: Our Kirtipur: a true-scale 3D map of old Kirtipur near Kathmandu, with six iconic places to pick for their history and photos. Every building from OpenStreetMap at a height from GHSL satellite data, the hill from SRTM heights as a smooth surface tinted in 2 m height bands, people walking the real lanes.
kicker: Floating map diorama · Kirtipur, Kathmandu valley · 1 unit = 4 m
intro: The old town at true scale, around six places: Uma Maheshwar, Lyaku Museum, Bagh Bhairab, Dey Pukhu, Lohan Dega and Chilancho.
canvasLabel: Isometric 3D map of Kirtipur old town: smooth hill tinted in 2 m height bands, extruded buildings from OpenStreetMap, temples, ponds and lanes, with map labels, floating on a rock island in the sky. Drag to turn, scroll to zoom, click the ground for its height or to measure.
